descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S01 「医院：处理前删掉的用药行（在用、暂停、停用）、一个任务和一条 Important Point，不出现在摘要和记录里」 Hospital: medication rows (active, held, stopped), a task and an Important Point deleted before processing stay out of the summary and the note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted before processing is not included in the summary (the pre-round Save Note result) or in the generated note.（UAT TC-24） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician. The Hospital patient is seeded with five medication rows, three open tasks and two Important Points, with no pre-round note and no generated note. A control Hospital patient 'QA Hosp Keep <tag>' carries the same point 'Check heel ulcer dressing'.

When Before any processing, delete the metoprolol (active), metformin (held) and tramadol (stopped) rows (Medications → Edit → Remove → Save Medications), the task 'Call daughter re: goals of care' (Encounter tab) and the point 'Check heel ulcer dressing' (pre-round notes editor), confirming each delete. …

Then Neither the pre-round summary nor the generated note mentions metoprolol, metformin, tramadol, the goals-of-care call or the heel ulcer, and the held-row refresh (3.6) does not restore the held rows. The note carries today's dictation. The items that were not deleted are still on the chart, and the control patient still has its own heel-ulcer point.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U1 (UAT TC-24 bullet 1). oracle.mjs: the summary and note checkpoints must not contain 'metoprolol', 'metformin', 'tramadol', 'goals of care' or 'heel ulcer'. Positive controls (oracleRules 1): 'Lisinopril' and 'Apixaban' on the summary (kept rows), 'PT eval before discharge' on the task list, and 'ceftriaxone' on the note (today's encounter text, not shown on Post-Round): a ' …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
